run_model_benchmarks: run model benchmarks for a given model with specified modes, batch sizes, and profiling options
verify_log: verify benchmark log DataFrame has correct row count, model names, and positive memory usage values
test_alexnet_benchmarks: test AlexNet model benchmarks with node ordering verification and address generation enabled
test_bert_benchmarks: test BERT model benchmarks across eval and train modes with batch sizes 1 and 32
test_resnet_benchmarks: test ResNet model benchmarks with default eval and train modes and address generation
